 1,857 seats across 32 courses- Rajasthan NEET PG counselling 2026 round 2 seat matrix OUT 
 Written By : Divyani Paul Published On 2026-11-16T15:00:44+05:30   |   Updated On 16 Nov 2026 3:00 PM IST 
 Rajasthan- The Rajasthan NEET PG Counselling Board has released the provisional seat matrix for Round 2 of Rajasthan NEET PG 2026 counselling, listing a total of 1,857 MD and MS seats across government, RUHS -CMS, society and private medical colleges in the state.
 The seat matrix has been issued by the Office of the Chairman, Rajasthan NEET PG Counselling Board-2026, SMS Medical College, Jaipur. It provides speciality-wise and college-wise distribution of postgraduate medical seats available for the second round of state counselling.
 Also Read: Rajasthan NEET PG 2026 Round 2 Counselling Schedule Released The official Round 2 matrix lists 350 seats in Government, Society and RUHS-CMS institutions and 1,507 seats in private medical colleges, taking the total to 1,857 PG MD/MS seats. The consolidated branch-wise distribution, including private AI nature, state and management seats, is provided in the PDF’s summary table. 
 Of the total seats listed, 350 seats are available across government, RUHS-CMS and society medical colleges, while 1,507 seats are listed in private medical colleges . Private medical colleges account for the larger share of the Round 2 seat matrix, with 1,507 PG seats listed across MD and MS specialities. 
 Overall, the Round 2 seat matrix includes 472 All India nature seats, 649 state seats and 170 management seats in private colleges, taking the total postgraduate seat pool across all participating institutions to 1,857 seats. Below is the detailed seat matrix-
